Otel.// OtlpEndpoint: Leave unset for `dotnet run` - traces/metrics print to console instead. To view them in a browser, run `docker run --rm -it -p 18888:18888 -p 18889:18889 -e DOTNET_DASHBOARD_UNSECURED_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS=true mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspire-dashboard:8.0`, then set OtlpEndpoint to http://localhost:18889 and open http://localhost:18888.
